chapterInfo.content:
13
Ahonisom ho kɔkɔbɔ
1Sɛ odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ bi sɔre wo mu, na ɔma wo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ anaa anwanwadeɛ bi, 2na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ anaa anwanwadeɛ a ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ no ba mu na ɔka sɛ: Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔdi anyame foforɔ a wonni wɔn akyi nkɔsom wɔn a, 3#Deut 8.2 ntie odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no nsɛm no. Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn resɔ mo ahwɛ na wahunu sɛ mode mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa bɛdɔ no anaa. 4AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn akyi na monnie, na ɔno na monsuro no, na ne mmara nsɛm so na monnie, na ne nne na montie, na monsom no, na mommata ne ho. 5#Deut 18.20; 1 Ko 5.9, 13 Na odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no, monku no, ɛfiri sɛ wakasa sɛ mommane mfiri AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii mo firii Misraim asase soɔ na ɔgyee mo firii nkoafie no ho de retwetwe wo afiri ɔkwan a wahyɛ wo sɛ nante mu no so; na tu bɔne no firi wo mu.
6Sɛ wo nuabarima, wo na ba anaa wo babarima anaa wo babaa anaa wo yere a ɔda wo kokom anaa w’adamfo a ɔte sɛ wo ara wo kra redaadaa wo kokoam sɛ: Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom anyame foforɔ a wo ne wo nananom nnim wɔn, 7amanaman a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia a wɔbɛn woɔ anaasɛ wɔmmɛn woɔ firi asase ano kɔsi asase ano nohoa anyame bi, a, 8mpene no na ntie no, na mma w’ani nnhu no mmɔbɔ, nanso mma no nnyɛ wo mmɔbɔ na mfa no nhunta. 9Na kum na ku no, wo nsa na ɛnni kan ntɔ ne so sɛ woreku no, na ɛno akyiri no ɔman no nyinaa nsa; 10na si no aboɔ ma no nwu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔrehwehwɛ atwetwe wo afiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo Misraim asase soɔ firii nkoafie no ho; 11na Israel nyinaa ntie na wɔnsuro, na wɔankɔ so anni wo mu asɛmmɔne a ɛte seyie.
12Sɛ wote wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woatena mu no bi nka sɛ: 13Mmarima mmabusufoɔ bi asɔre wo mu adaadaa wɔn nkurɔfoɔ sɛ: Momma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom anyame foforɔ a monnim wɔn a, 14ɛnneɛ hwehwɛ mu na bisabisa mu yie; na hwɛ sɛ asɛm no wom ampa sɛ wɔayɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi wɔ wo mu a, 15#Num 21.2 kum na fa nkrantɛ kum kuro no mufoɔ. Fa nkrantɛ sɛe ɛno ne deɛ ɛwom nyinaa ne emu afieboa pasapasa; 16na boaboa emu asadeɛ nyinaa ano gu abɔntene so, na fa ogya hye kuro no ne emu asadeɛ no nyinaa sɛ afɔdeɛ mu ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na ɛnyɛ daa amamfo a wɔnnkyekyere bio. 17#Yos 7 Na mma abusudeɛ no bi nnka wo nsam; na AWURADE nnane mfiri n’abufuhyeɛ no ho, na ɔnhu wo mmɔbɔ, na ne yam nhyehye no mma wo, na ɔmma wonnɔɔso sɛdeɛ ɔkaa wo nananom ntam no. 18Sɛ wobɛtie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne adi ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so ayɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani so a.

Sɛ odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ bi sɔre wo mu, na ɔma wo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ anaa anwanwadeɛ bi, na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ anaa anwanwadeɛ a ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ no ba mu na ɔka sɛ: Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔdi anyame foforɔ a wonni wɔn akyi nkɔsom wɔn a, ntie odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no nsɛm no. Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn resɔ mo ahwɛ na wahunu sɛ mode mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa bɛdɔ no anaa. AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn akyi na monnie, na ɔno na monsuro no, na ne mmara nsɛm so na monnie, na ne nne na montie, na monsom no, na mommata ne ho. Na odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no, monku no, ɛfiri sɛ wakasa sɛ mommane mfiri AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii mo firii Misraim asase soɔ na ɔgyee mo firii nkoafie no ho de retwetwe wo afiri ɔkwan a wahyɛ wo sɛ nante mu no so; na tu bɔne no firi wo mu.
Sɛ wo nuabarima, wo na ba anaa wo babarima anaa wo babaa anaa wo yere a ɔda wo kokom anaa w’adamfo a ɔte sɛ wo ara wo kra redaadaa wo kokoam sɛ: Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom anyame foforɔ a wo ne wo nananom nnim wɔn, amanaman a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia a wɔbɛn woɔ anaasɛ wɔmmɛn woɔ firi asase ano kɔsi asase ano nohoa anyame bi, a, mpene no na ntie no, na mma w’ani nnhu no mmɔbɔ, nanso mma no nnyɛ wo mmɔbɔ na mfa no nhunta. Na kum na ku no, wo nsa na ɛnni kan ntɔ ne so sɛ woreku no, na ɛno akyiri no ɔman no nyinaa nsa; na si no aboɔ ma no nwu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔrehwehwɛ atwetwe wo afiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo Misraim asase soɔ firii nkoafie no ho; na Israel nyinaa ntie na wɔnsuro, na wɔankɔ so anni wo mu asɛmmɔne a ɛte seyie.
Sɛ wote wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woatena mu no bi nka sɛ: Mmarima mmabusufoɔ bi asɔre wo mu adaadaa wɔn nkurɔfoɔ sɛ: Momma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom anyame foforɔ a monnim wɔn a, ɛnneɛ hwehwɛ mu na bisabisa mu yie; na hwɛ sɛ asɛm no wom ampa sɛ wɔayɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi wɔ wo mu a, kum na fa nkrantɛ kum kuro no mufoɔ. Fa nkrantɛ sɛe ɛno ne deɛ ɛwom nyinaa ne emu afieboa pasapasa; na boaboa emu asadeɛ nyinaa ano gu abɔntene so, na fa ogya hye kuro no ne emu asadeɛ no nyinaa sɛ afɔdeɛ mu ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na ɛnyɛ daa amamfo a wɔnnkyekyere bio. Na mma abusudeɛ no bi nnka wo nsam; na AWURADE nnane mfiri n’abufuhyeɛ no ho, na ɔnhu wo mmɔbɔ, na ne yam nhyehye no mma wo, na ɔmma wonnɔɔso sɛdeɛ ɔkaa wo nananom ntam no. Sɛ wobɛtie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne adi ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so ayɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani so a.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
